responsive.mobile_nav: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile screens (<= 768px) with 5 main action tabs: Home, Jobs, Community/Feed, Messages, Profile/Dashboard. Desktop uses sticky top glassmorphism navbar.
responsive.layout_reflow: All desktop multi-column grids collapse to 1 column on mobile (<640px). Sidebars collapse into drawers or tabs. Hero sections stack visually with text first, visual card/preview second.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full overflow-hidden on outer containers, min-w-0 on flex/grid children to avoid mobile horizontal scroll glitches.
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum touch target height 44px for buttons, nav items, input fields, and tab toggles.

component_specifications.landing_page: Hero with badge ('Richfield & AAA Employability Network'), bold typography, dynamic live metrics ticker, benefits breakdown for Students/Alumni/Employers, interactive AI Assistant preview card, and clear CTA.
component_specifications.auth_and_verification: Role selector (Student, Alumni, Employer, Admin). Alumni verification form with graduation year & degree ID. Employer verification with company registration & domain approval status.
component_specifications.profile_page: LinkedIn-style banner + avatar + headline + completion progress bar. Skills list with endorsement counters, recommendations section, and activity history.
component_specifications.application_pipeline: Kanban-style application tracker (Applied -> Under Review -> Shortlisted -> Interview -> Accepted/Rejected) with drag or quick-status update buttons.
component_specifications.ai_features: Job match percentage gauge with match breakdown bullet points. Career path interactive roadmap node explorer. AI CV Upload parser with extraction preview dialog.
component_specifications.social_feed: Feed with post creator (text, image, video attachment mock), likes, comments, author badges, and role filter tabs.
component_specifications.dashboards: Role-specific metric cards with Recharts graphs (Employability scores, Application trends, Employer candidate conversion, Admin audit/moderation logs).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, links) have explicit data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide icons for UI controls and standardizing icon sizes (w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5).
Make sure every tab switch and modal opening is responsive and includes state persistence where applicable.
Include simulated real-time notifications with Sonner toast triggers.
Follow mobile-first layout rules: cards full width on mobile, stack navigation neatly, and provide a mobile bottom navigation bar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered slop layout. Use strong asymmetric visual hierarchy.
Every interaction needs micro-animations and visible hover/focus states.
Never use dark full-screen gradients. Keep surfaces solid or tinted with subtle border definition.
Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit hover text colors.
